t: What exactly is buying a home as-is : r/FirstTimeHomeBuyer
s: July 9, 2022 - Is your realtor saying to waive inspection or buy as-is? In the latter you're basically saying you won't renegotiate based on inspection but you reserve the right to walk with your deposit. It's more attractive to the seller because you're saying "unless it's something big I won't back out".
